name: Good Honey Creamed Clover, 16oz
description:
The Ashusrt Family are 5th generation bee keepers, home harvesting honey in the USA since 1919.

Their Montana Creamed Clover honey is their raw and pure, using their unique creaming method. Good Honey’s creamed clover is whipped and chilled to perfection, creating a luxuriously smooth and spreadable texture. Crafted from only the finest clover blossoms, their creamed honey boasts a rich and delicate sweetness with a perfect velvety finish. It’s great for spreading over warm toast, stirring into tea, or enjoying by the spoonful!

name: Good Honey Montana Clover, 16oz
description:
The Ashusrt Family are 5th generation bee keepers, home harvesting honey in the USA since 1919.

Their Montana Clover Honey is the Olympic gold medal of honeys. When Montana Clover blooms in the summer months, Beekeepers and bees alike spend countless hours looking for this liquid gold. Although there are over 300 varieties of clover flowers, Montana Sweet Clover (Melilotus officinalis) is prized for its superior taste. They harvest it as a pure Montana clover, meaning it is not blended with other varieties, and is among some of the lightest colored honeys produced. Our favorite quality is its candied sweetness. If you’re looking for the most premium & tasty honey, look no further!

Delicate and sweet with clean floral notes. (A finishing honey)

name: La Trinquelinette Apricot Jam, 370g
description: This apricot jam is made in a small batches by a small family business in the village of Saint-Léger-Vauban in the Burgundy region. This area of France is known for its fertile soil and vineyards. All their jams are made with local fruit and brown unrefined sugar. Some of the jams are thicken with pectinei and some use rhubarb.Not too sweet, but sweet enough - perfect for your toasted baguette, French butter & coffee!

name: Pojer e Sandri Quince Syrup, 150g
description:
Pojer e Sandri Cold Pressed Quince Syrup is made from 100% cold concentrated quince juice, and nothing else.

Their estate’s orchard is located at 700 meters and is surrounded by forest, an ideal location for organically cultivating two varieties of quince, Ronda and Silver. Every fall, they cold press carefully selected fruit into juice. Using a unique vacuum processing, Pojer e Sandri are able to concentrate the quince juice to a thick, maple syrup consistency without adding any sugar. Thus, the intrinsic characteristics of the quince remain intact in the final product.

Pojer e Sandri has truly captured the essence of quince. Unlike most sugary syrups, this Quince Syrup bursts with a tannic tartness balanced by just enough natural sweetness. The quince fruit’s distinct aromas and notes of plum, molasses, and pine are concentrated. One spoonful packs a flavorful punch that evokes the mountainous region from which it originates.

name: Girl Meets Dirt Ginny Jam, 7.75oz
description:
In an orchard by the sea (Warm Valley Orchard) lies a grove of old Italian Plum trees, harvested by long time islanders Bob & Maria Nutt. These beautiful plums have been crated off to Seattle the past few years to be soaked with botanicals in gin by Copperworks Distilling for their lauded & award winning Plum Gin (side note, Bob is brothers with Copperworks Founder Micah and Audra bought her first Shiro Plums aside from the farmette tree, from the Nutt family).

A few years back we fielded a call from Copperworks- basically- hey- we’ve got these boozy plums we normally compost but maybe you want them? HECK YA we do.

So in true full circle fashion we picked up a truckload of buckets of the inaugural 2021 season island Italian plums that had spent most of 2022 on the lash in a gin bath and brought them back home. We rolled up our sleeves and hand pitted each and every one of them, added some sugar and a squeeze of lemon to the party and have an exquisite new limited edition preserve!

name: Girl Meets Dirt Hot Damn Pepper Jam Spoon Preserves, 7.75oz
description:
The Girl Meets Dirt crew is really into fruit, but their farmers grow great vegetables too! Time to fire up the peppers. The result is a not so usual pepper jelly. They gave it the old GMD spin and maxxed out the spiciness but added lots of local fruit and a bit of punchy organic vinegar (made from WA apples) for balance. The quince and apple add body to the set allowing GMD to stay committed to their ‘no pectin’ policy. It’s legit hot (yes!). It’s legit amazing. And it’s all natural.

This is one of those jars you need in your refrigerator to spice up lackluster meals (visualize dipping coconut shrimp or topping grilled salmon) and serve as an instant cheese pairing by slathering on cream cheese and crackers at a moment’s notice. They're a game-changer for any charcuterie board or cheeseboard!

name: Girl Meets Dirt Orcas Pear, 7.75oz
description: At the height of ripeness Girl Meets Dirt picks Orcas Island pears and cooks them into a rosy preserve, with notes of ginger from their fresh kitchen garden grown bay leaves. Highly versatile, this preserve is a gorgeous topping to pannacotta and cheesecake.

name: Girl Meets Dirt Pear Balsamic. 7.75oz
description: This jam is always a star on a cheeseboard or grazing board with taleggio, asiago and blues. Truly an all-purpose condiment – try it over ice cream. Or play around – add a few glugs of balsamic to a teaspoonful, extra virgin olive oil, salt, and minced shallots and puree it together for a quick, rich vinaigrette for a salad (topped with blue cheese, fresh pear slices, and crispy shallots). Spoon it over a wedge of Rogue River Blue with wafer thin crackers or fresh pear slices for an intensely satisfying cheese pairing.

name: Casina Rossa Saffron & Acacia Honey, 140g
description: Casina Rossa is a brand of artisan food products from the Abruzzo region of Italy created by Nicola and Paola DeLaurentiis. Their Saffron & Acacia Honey is complements aged cheeses, ice cream, or even roasted chicken or scallops.

name: Chateau Miraval Lavendar Honey, 500g
description: Château Miraval Lavender Honey is a rare, limited-edition, raw honey produced directly on the Provence property, often harvested in the summer or fall by resident beekeeper Noel Patterson. It is known for its delicate floral taste and creamy texture, reflecting the aromatic lavender fields surrounding the estate.

name: Dalmatia Fig & Orange Spread, 240g
description: Dalmatia combines the sweetness of Croatian figs with the zesty pop of coastal oranges. Made with care using hand-selected fruits, this is the perfect accompaniment to your charcuterie or cheese board. It pairs nicely with blue cheeses such as Bleu des Basque or Mitibleu, bloomy rind cheeses such as Brie du Pommier or Fromage de Meaux, or with fresh ricotta and walnuts over toasted bread. It’s not limited to cheese, however. It’s the perfect complement to your morning coffee when spread liberally on toast with butter.

name: Dalmatia Fig Spread, 240g
description: As good on toast as it is with aged sheep's milk cheese, this spread is made with figs from the Croatian coast. After we tried it for the first time, we knew it had to be on our shelves. This spread pairs well with almost any cheese - from rich and creamy to dry and sharp. Love figs, but not with cheese? No problem. Spread liberally on toast with butter and enjoy with your morning coffee!

name: Dalmatia Sour Cherry Spread, 240g
description: Dalmatia uses perfectly-ripened Croatian sour cherries to make this delightful spread. A popular charcuterie board recommendation from our deli staff, this spread pairs especially well with tangy goat cheeses such as Florette, Humboldt Fog, or Bocconcino di Langa. It also makes an excellent filling for chocolate cake or cookies!

name: Formaticum Cheese Bags, 15 count
tagline: Makes your cheese last longer & taste better!
description: Cheese is a living thing, and like all living things, it requires certain conditions to thrive. These French-made cheese storage bags provide the ideal environment for cheese to maintain its best qualities in your home refrigerator. Breathable enough to keep the cultures in the cheese alive, while still retaining enough humidity to avoid drying. Each package contains fifteen bags. A perfect gift for the discerning cheese lover!

name: Formaticum Cheese Papers, 20 count
tagline: Makes your cheese last longer & taste better!
description: Cheese is a living thing, and like all living things, it requires certain conditions to thrive. These French-made cheese storage papers are specially designed to keep cheese at its best in your home refrigerator. The paper allows cheese to breathe, while still retaining enough moisture to prevent drying. Each package contains fifteen sheets of paper and fifteen stickers. A perfect gift for the discerning cheese lover!

name: Wedge Cheese Knives, 3 set
description:
Holcomb Studio's Wedge Cheese Knives are designed with sharp geometric blades and elongated frosted sage handles, adding depth and interest to any cheese board. The set includes three knives tailored for hard cheeses, soft cheeses, and every cheese in between. Their sharp, pointed blades make slicing and serving cheese easy.

The Wedge Cheese Knives are made of high-polished stainless steel and Tritan, and are dishwasher safe. Seemlessly blending modernity with natural, timeless materials, these knives are a stunning and handy addition to your kitchen!
